attributes.name: Immolation Cloak
attributes.powers:
Reveal this card to reduce Fire damage dealt to you to 0.

Recharge this card to add 1d8 for each of your mythic charges and the Fire trait to any combat check by a character at your location; you are dealt 1 Fire damage.

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if proficient with light armors, bury it instead.

corrections.corrected_text: On the armors Immolation Cloak and Mantle of Faith, add the Clothing trait.
corrections.issue: Immolation Cloak and Mantle of Faith both have the Magic trait but lack the recharge power common to most other armors that have the Magic trait. That usually only happens when the armor also has the Clothing trait. Should these armors have the Clothing trait?
